content: I'm into Your matchbook slogans/photos "In Winston Racing, Nation people are free to disagree, burn a smoke, etc,"
CAs I like Round Table Pizza's "Bill of Rights," saying people have the "right to pig out," etc.)
I am especially struck by Your phrase "No boundaries."
This is the most powerful advertising phrase I have ever heard.
Suggestion: Make it up as pins or patches. I'm going to make one Myself, a canvas panel to pin on (punk style).
